purpose: Iteration 10 browser handoff: how each ramify.check/3 path disposition and project verdict reaches the harness records, transcript protocol and engineer text after iteration 4.

verdict.providerField: process exit code with document outcome/reason (ramify.check/3) or outcome.execution/check (ramify.analysis/3)
verdict.adapter: RamifyCheckResult.outcome: checked (exit 0) | findings (exit 1) | not-checked (exit 2, reason = CLI reason or ramify.analysis/3 execution); unsupported (undecodable) is not-checked with reason 'unsupported result: <detail>'
verdict.records: hook-check observation data.outcome: passed | findings | not-checked; data.reason; transcript post-write-check checks[].outcome/reason
verdict.rule: The verdict is the project's. It says nothing about a path whose disposition is not checked.

provider.records: hook-check data.provider and transcript checks[].provider: { schema: 'ramify.check/3' | 'ramify.analysis/3', revision: revision id or null } | null
provider.nullWhen: no document was decoded: unsupported result, invocation failure, a check that was not run (changed set unknown)

dispositions.records: hook-check data.dispositions[] and transcript checks[].dispositions[]: { path, disposition, reason, module, exclusion: { kind, directory, owner } | null, sha256 }
dispositions.emptyWhen: complete checks (ramify.analysis/3 has no per-path list), undecoded results and unrun checks

rows.engineerText: named only inside a not-checked block, as '- <path>: checked (content)'
as above, '(deleted)'; clears the file's standing findings when the result was established
'Not analyzed by Ramify: ... is no pass for them.' then '- <path>: in the <kind> tree|scratch directory `<directory>` of module `<owner>` [not-analyzed <reason>]', whatever the verdict
'- <path>: a reserved path of module `<module>` [not-analyzed reserved]' when no exclusion is given
'- <path>: an owned file of module `<module>` that is neither source nor an analysis input [not-analyzed owned-non-source]'
head line '- changed check over <paths>: not-checked (<reason>)'; a path with a reason other than the check's is listed under it as '- <path>: not checked (<reason>)'

settlement.covered: changed: paths with disposition checked; complete: every analyzed path ('all'); only when the result was established (exit 0/1, decoded)
settlement.removed: document removed[] ids clear only when established and execution is completed
settlement.exit2: reported findings are admitted and stand; nothing clears
settlement.uncovered: standing findings of not-analyzed and not-checked paths are kept (union), never replaced

gaps.unsupported-check-result: coverage-gap observation per check whose printed result the adapter refused; never a pass
gaps.changed-paths-unknown: unchanged: the only case that runs a complete check instead

warnings.relay: '[warning <code>]' with Ramify's own message, not blocking, for a file this invocation wrote that the warning lists or that lies under its path; repeated warnings are told once
